questions.q: What does the author say is needed for an upheaval to lead to a positive result?
options: This is not the condition named.
Every future result needs present preparation.
This is not the condition named.
The author doubts that this is enough.
questions.rationale: Only a prepared society or educated society is the guarantee that this kind of upheaval may lead to a positive result.

questions.q: Which physicist is quoted as saying ‘God is a mathematician of a very high order’?
options: The Nobel Prize winning physicist is quoted in the article.
He is quoted as saying all things are numbers.
He is quoted as saying the Lord is subtle.
To Picasso, God was an artist.
questions.rationale: Nobel Prize winning physicist, Paul Dirac has said ‘God is a mathematician of a very high order.’

questions.q: Because all food crops may be wiped out, which strategy does the article mention?
options: Building a vault to preserve seeds
One of the strategies has been to build a vault.
questions.rationale: Since it is feared that all food crops may be wiped off the face of the earth, one of the strategies has been to build a vault.

questions.q: What does the article name as the opposite of spirituality?
options: Giving all one’s attention to worldly things and appearances.
Science is not named as its opposite.
questions.rationale: The opposite of spirituality is materialism, a course followed all too often in this world.

questions.q: Why do people not marvel at the birth of a child?
options: It is a daily occurrence, so they take it for granted
People have become used to the sight.
questions.rationale: A child born to a mother is a daily occurrence. People have become used to this sight. They take it for granted.

questions.q: How did one scientist typify the earth’s life support system?
options: This is not the phrase quoted.
This is not the phrase quoted.
“The right type of material at the right place”
This phrase is quoted in the article.
The article says no planet similar to earth has been found.
questions.rationale: One scientist typified it as “the right type of material at the right place.”

questions.article: World Religions and the Spirit of Tolerance
questions.q: Into which two categories does the article divide the great religions?
options: These are not the terms used.
Tolerance is given equal importance in both.
These are not the terms used.
These are not the terms used.
questions.rationale: All the great religions of the world can be broadly divided into two categories: Aryan religions and Semitic religions.

questions.q: What does the article say the policy of reservation implies?
options: This is not what the article says.
The article says people no longer had to compete.
It says this led to lethargy.
questions.rationale: Such a policy implies ‘achievement without hard work’.

questions.q: Where did the Angel Gabriel first appear to the Prophet Muhammad in A.D. 610?
options: The article names the Cave of Hira.
In the Cave of Hira on Mount An-Nur
He used to retreat there to think deeply about life.
The article names the Cave of Hira near Mecca.
questions.rationale: One night in the year A.D. 610, the Angel Gabriel appeared to him in this cave. He commanded him: “Read, in the name of your Lord!”

questions.q: According to the verse quoted (10: 5), why were stages ordained for the moon?
options: This is not in the verse.
So that people may count the years and reckon time
This is the purpose stated in the verse.
To mark the seasons of rain
This is not in the verse.
The verse speaks of reckoning time.
questions.rationale: He ordained for it stages so that you may learn to count out the years and [to make other such] reckoning of time.
